This contract provides labor to support workload surges, unforeseen/unplanned workload, contingency operations and special projects. The modification would increase the ceiling amount as the contract has been outpacing the anticipated spend rate. Pursuant to the exception under FAR 6.302-1(a)(2)(iii), only Olgoonik Federal, LLC is capable of providing the services at this time; award to any other source will result in unacceptable delays and would preclude DLA from reacting timely to requirements. This action could not have been overcome by advanced planning given the nature of this contract, which is to support unplanned, unforeseen requirements. If the contract ceiling is not increased to accommodate the known and anticipated requirements of this contract, as well as any unplanned requirements, DLA Distribution would not have a contract vehicle to provide services within the scope of this contract to support DLA and its customers mission. The modification to current contract SP3300-21-D-5002 will serve as a temporary solution to fulfill immediate mission requirements. A follow-on procurement is in process. The justification and approval for this ceiling increase will be posted as part of this notice once executed. This is not a solicitation for proposals or an invitation for bids. The Government does not anticipate receiving responses to this notice of a non-competitive action.

description: Die Auftraggeberin beabsichtigt die Beschaffung von mindestens einem und bis zu 8 sowie bis zu 2 Niederflur-Gelenkbussen mit Elektroantrieb (Elektrobusse) zur Elektrifizierung der Busflotte. Die technischen Anforderungen und weiteren Leistungsgegenstände sind der Anlage 6 zu entnehmen. Der Einsatz der Elektrobusse soll im öffentlichen Personennahverkehr erfolgen. Die abschließende Planung, ob Elektrobusse benötigt werden, wie viele Elektrobusse und welche Gefäßgrößen benötigt werden und in welchem Verkehr sie eingesetzt werden, konnte bisher nicht erfolgen. Aufgrund zuwendungsrechtlicher Fristen konnte die abschließende Planung nicht abgewartet werden. Daher schreibt die Auftraggeberin eine Rahmenvereinbarung für die Elektrobusse aus (vgl. Anlage 8 § 2). Die Auftraggeberin wird, abhängig vom Bedarf, mindestens einen maximal 8 Solo-Fahrzeuge und 0 bis 2 Gelenkbusse aus der Rahmenvereinbarung abrufen. Eine Abnahmeverpflichtung über den einen Solobus hinaus besteht für die Auftraggeberin aus der Rahmenvereinbarung nicht. Spätester Liefertermin für die Fahrzeuge ist der 1.7.2028. Frühester Liefertermin ist der 1.6.2028.

title: Germany – Public-service buses – Elektrifizierung der Linienbusflotte – Rahmenvereinbarung für die Neubeschaffung bis zu einem Niederflur-Elektro-Gelenkbusses und bis zu sechs 12 Meter Niederflur-Elektro-Solobusse für die Hausemann & Mager GmbH & Co. KG
description: Ziel dieser Ausschreibung ist die Beschaffung bis zu einem Niederflur-Elektro-Gelenkbusses und bis zu sechs Niederflur-Elektro-Solobusse für die Hausemann & Mager GmbH. Hiermit soll die bestehende Fahrzeugflotte gezielt modernisiert und im innerstädtischen Linienbetrieb zunehmend auf emissionsfreie Fahrzeuge umgestellt werden. Das übergeordnete Ziel des Projekts besteht darin, den öffentlichen Personennahverkehr nachhaltiger, umweltfreundlicher und leiser zu gestalten und damit einen aktiven Beitrag zum Klimaschutz sowie zur Verbesserung der Luftqualität zu leisten. Die ausgeschriebene Leistung umfasst die Lieferung betriebsbereiter Neufahrzeuge, die sämtliche technischen und funktionalen Anforderungen der Vergabeunterlagen erfüllen. Der Einsatz moderner Elektrobusse trägt dazu bei, den Fahrgastkomfort zu erhöhen, die Barrierefreiheit weiter zu verbessern, die Energieeffizienz zu steigern sowie die langfristige Leistungsfähigkeit eines zeitgemäßen öffentlichen Verkehrsangebots sicherzustellen. Folgende Hauptleistungen sind Inhalt dieser Ausschreibung: - Lieferung eines betriebsbereiten Niederflur-Elektro-Gelenkbusses - Einweisung der Mitarbeitenden der Hausemann & Mager GmbH - Durchführung von Bedienerschulungen gemäß DGUV Die Rahmenvereinbarung wird in zwei Fachlosen vergeben. Los 1 - Lieferung bis zu einem betriebsbereiten Niederflur‑Elektro‑Gelenkbusses einschließ-lich Einweisung des Bedienpersonals Los 2 - Lieferung von bis zu sechs betriebsbereiten Niederflur Elektro Solobussen ein-schließlich Einweisung des Bedienpersonals

title: Switzerland – Railway engineering services – MP PRm2-m3 MA 2026 009 - Mandataire Système (MA SYS) et Assistance à maîtrise d’ouvrage Système (AMO SYS)
description: Sous l'impulsion de la planification coordonnée régionale, cantonale et de l'agglomération, le programme de développement des métros m2-m3 (programme m2-m3) a été articulé pour répondre à deux objectifs principaux: * Renforcer la capacité de transport entre la gare et le centre ville afin de répondre à la demande générée par l'offre ferroviaire à la gare de Lausanne, * Lier les sites des Plaines-du-Loup et de la Tuilière au centre ville de Lausanne. Le métro m3 reliera directement la gare des CFF à Chauderon, sans arrêt au Flon. Cela permettra de créer une nouvelle interface majeure de mobilité au centre ville à Chauderon, grâce à une liaison souterraine avec la rue de Genève, notamment, et de mieux organiser le réseau de transports publics, pour une meilleure répartition des voyageurs. Le métro m2 sera quant à lui modernisé en priorité, c'est-à-dire que ses automatismes, qui lui permettent de fonctionner sans conducteur à bord, seront remplacés et ses rames rénovées. Sa capacité sera augmentée. Des prestations initiales de mandataires Système et Equipements ont été réalisées à la suite de deux appels d'offres de l'Etat de Vaud. En raison de la modification des mécanismes de financement et des besoins organisationnels des projets, les tl souhaitent adjuger 2 nouveaux mandats pour effectuer la suite du projet par le biais du présent appel d'offres.

description: Cette consultation concerne la gestion locative et technique de 54 ensembles immobiliers (dont 431 existants et 23 neufs ) totalisant 10.615 logements situés sur l’ensemble du territoire national (69 départements). La présente consultation concerne deux types de mission : 1°) l’administration de biens, complète, d’un ensemble immobilier ; la gestion locative et technique sera globale et concernera à la fois les parties privatives et les parties communes, partielles ou totales ; 2°) l’administration de biens de logements situés dans des ensembles immobiliers en copropriété ; la gestion locative et technique ne concernera que les parties privatives, ainsi que la gestion des relations avec le syndic et la représentation du mandant. Dans les deux cas la mission englobe la recherche de locataires pour les logements vacants sauf avis contraire de l’Association. Elle concerne deux types de biens différents : - Logements à loyers conventionnés : programmes conventionnés déjà en service pour lesquels le mandat de gestion actuel arrive à son terme - Logements à loyers libres : programmes à loyer libre déjà en service (pour lesquels le mandat de gestion actuel arrive à son terme), ou neufs (dont la livraison correspond à la date d’effet du mandat, réalisés dans des quartiers à dominante de logement social, ou à proximité immédiate) Les conditions générales des mandats sont identiques pour les deux types de biens, mais les conditions particulières différent selon que les programmes sont neufs ou existants. • Le gestionnaire sera le mandataire des SCI propriétaires ; il devra gérer l’ensemble immobilier au nom et pour le compte du mandant, dans le respect des dispositions de la loi dite loi « Hoguet » du 2 janvier 1970, et des textes venus la compléter ou la modifier et également de la loi n° 2014-366 du 24 mars 2014 (ALUR). A cet égard, il est précisé que les missions objet des contrats conclus avec les gestionnaires sont pleinement soumis à l’ensemble de cette réglementation ou toute réglementation ultérieure, sans qu’il soit nécessaire de modifier les mandats, et que les gestionnaires sont tenus d’une obligation de respect cette réglementation dans la réalisation de l’ensemble des actes et prestations objet des mandats de gestion ; • Il devra assurer au mieux des intérêts du mandant la gestion administrative de l’ensemble immobilier (validation des dossiers des candidats locataires et organisation des visites, gestion des baux de location et de l’APL, gestion du contentieux locatif, administration de l’ensemble immobilier, gardiennage, etc.). • Il assurera également la gestion technique de l’ensemble immobilier, y compris la prise de possession des biens neufs au cours de laquelle il représentera le mandant, les états des lieux, les contrats de maintenance et d’entretien, les travaux d’entretien courant, les travaux de gros entretien et de grosses réparations, la gestion des sinistres, la consultation des entreprises. • Il procèdera à la gestion comptable et à la reddition des comptes. • Il devra assurer l’information du mandant par un « reporting » permanent et régulier, en utilisant des supports mis à sa disposition par le mandant (notamment un portail Internet), dans des délais déterminés sous peine de sanctions. Il se soumettra à tous les contrôles, enquêtes et audits, directs du mandant ou que celui-ci fera réaliser par des intervenants extérieurs ou encore qui seraient réalisés par les organismes de contrôle auxquels le mandant est soumis (exemple : audit ou enquête de l’Ancols ou de la Cour des comptes). Il s’engage à fournir toutes explications et documents qui lui seraient réclamés et à coopérer de bonne foi avec Foncière logement, ses filiales et les organismes de contrôle

description: Das AKK plant auf dem Gelände Bleickenallee 38 in Hamburg Altona Umbaumaßnahmen im Gebäude "Reha Aufstockung" um drei weitere Geschosse. Das Bestandsgebäude ist teilunterkellert, im Untergeschoss befinden sich Technikräume und Umkleiden, das Erdgeschoss wird weiterhin als Rehabilitationseinrichtung genutzt. Das Reha-Gebäude wird gemäß § 2 HBauO in die Gebäudeklasse 5 eingestuft. Im 1. Obergeschoss der Aufstockung wird eine teilstationäre Tagesklinik untergebracht, die als Ersatzfläche für die Baufeldfreimachung des Ersatzneubaus I-Haus dient. Die Station beinhaltet überwiegend Untersuchungsräume für diagnostische Zwecke sowie Liegeräume, in denen Patienten Infusionen erhalten. Dienende Räume wie Stützpunkt, Arbeits- und Lagerräume, Sanitärräume und Verteilküche ergänzen das Raumangebot. Die dreigeschossige Aufstockung wird in Stahlbetonbauweise errichtet, bestehend aus tragenden Außenwänden sowie tragenden Wänden und Stützen im Gebäudeinnern. Die Decken werden aus Fertigteilelementen in Verbundbauweise als Spannbeton-Hohlplattendecken mit deckengleichen Verbundträgern geplant. Die Außenwände erhalten ein WDVS-System mit Riemchenverkleidung. Die Aufstockung erhält ein extensiv begrüntes Flachdach mit Photovoltaikmodulen. Die Baumaßnahme soll unter Aufrechterhaltung des laufenden Krankenhausbetriebes erfolgen. Die Zufahrt zur Baustelle erfolgt über die Lisztstraße; sämtliche Zuwege zu Ein- und Ausgängen sowie Feuerwehr- und Rettungswagenzufahrten sind in jedem Fall freizuhalten. title: Norway – Vehicles for refuse – Electric refuse collection vehicles in several sub-contracts.
description: Background The contracting authority needs to procure several new refuse collection vehicles as a part of replacing older vehicles and to cover an increased capacity need in the sanitation service. The procurement shall contribute to ensuring operationally secure, future orientated and sufficiently dimensioned vehicle park for various collection and transport assignments. The need includes several types of vehicles suitable for different routes and operational assignments. The vehicles shall be able to be used under varying operational conditions, and the contracting authority therefore needs deliveries that are suitable for ordinary sanitation operations, including the accompanying service and follow-up needs. All the procured vehicles shall be electric. In order to facilitate appropriate competition, good market adaptation and effective contract follow-up, the procurement is planned divided into separate sub-contracts per vehicle type. Description of the assignment The procurement is for the complete delivery of electric sanitation vehicles in several categories. The delivery includes both standard refuse collection vehicles and special vehicles for various sanitation and transport purposes, including vehicles with, among other things, automatic lifts, several chambers, hook lifts, lifts, cranes and planes. The procurement is divided into seven sub-contracts. Tenderers can submit tenders for one or more sub-contracts. Several tenders can also be submitted for the same sub-contract. The Contracting Authority requests tenders for the following vehicles: Nine 6x2 refuse collection vehicles, one chamber with automatic lift. 4 4x2 refuse collection vehicles, one chamber with a comb lift. 1 6x2 refuse collection vehicle, 2 chambers with a short wheelbase. 1 6x2 lift manholes 1 6x2 hook lift 1 8x4 sanitation vehicle with a crane and washing facilities. 1 6x2 plan vehicle with a crane. The delivery shall be complete and it shall include the necessary vehicles with additions and relevant equipment for the relevant use areas. In addition a service contract, access to spare parts and telematics shall be included. Further requirements for the performance, technical specifications, functionality and contract structure will be in the tender documentation and the accompanying requirement specifications.

title: Netherlands – Social work services – SAS-procedure Wmo Begeleiding Gemeente Coevorden en Borger-Odoorn
description: De huidige Wmo-maatwerkovereenkomsten voor begeleiding zijn niet langer passend bij de actuele wet- en regelgeving, jurisprudentie en gemeentelijke beleidswensen. Het resultaatgericht indiceren waarop de overeenkomsten zijn gebaseerd, is door uitspraken van de Centrale Raad van Beroep niet toegestaan. Daarnaast tonen interne signalen en interne onderzoek aan dat de huidige opzet risico’s kent voor rechtmatigheid, doelmatigheid en kwaliteit van zorg. Ook sluiten de bestaande overeenkomsten onvoldoende aan bij nieuwe wensen, zoals verbeterde regie op ureninzet, het gebruik van het HHM-normenkader en de wens om de nieuwe Wmo Contractstandaarden toe te passen. Hierdoor is besloten om de huidige overeenkomsten vervroegd te beëindigen per 1 augustus 2027 en een nieuwe procedure te starten. Op basis van de gegevens uit voorgaande jaren wordt de opdrachtwaarde voor begeleiding binnen de gemeenten Coevorden en Borger-Odoorn geraamd op €3.288.750 per jaar exclusief btw. De totale geraamde waarde van de opdracht per gemeente bedraagt circa: Coevorden Begeleiding: € 13.010.000 exclusief btw Borger-Odoorn Begeleiding: € 13.300.000 exclusief btw Uitgaande van een maximale looptijd van acht (8) jaar, inclusief verlengingsopties, bedraagt de totale geraamde waarde € 26.310.000 exclusief btw. Omdat er vooraf niet nauwkeurig kan worden bepaald welke prijsontwikkelingen en veranderingen zich gedurende de looptijd van de overeenkomst zullen voordoen, wordt een marge van maximaal 50% gehanteerd. Hierdoor komt de maximale opdrachtwaarde uit op €39.465.000 exclusief btw.

Yksiköitä on tällä hetkellä yhteensä kuusi: Riihimäellä kaksi (Sakonkatu 1 ja Teollisuuskatu 22a) ja Hyvinkäällä neljä (Karankatu 3–5, Kauppalankatu 18, Uudenmaankatu 249 ja Uudenmaankatu 20). Yksiköiden yhteenlaskettu bruttoala on noin 50.000 m2. Yksiköt ovat valmistuneet eri vuosikymmenillä ja niihin on tehty perusparannuksia vuosien mittaan. Hyriassa on käynnissä laaja kiinteistöstrategia, joka vaikuttaa muun muassa yksiköiden määrään. Näiden lisäksi Hyrialla on toimintaa vuokrakohteissa, joihin saatetaan myös tilata rakennustöitä. Solmittavan sopimuksen kohteena Hyria koulutus Oy:n kohteissa tehtävät pienet ja keskisuuret vuosikorjaustyöt, sekä muut rakennusyöt mahdollisine purkutöineen, pois lukien suuret urakat. Korjaustyöt ovat Hyrian vuosikorjausohjelman mukaisia töitä sekä akuutteja pienempiä rakennus- ja korjaustöitä. Tarjoajalla tulee olla kyky vastata nopealla aikataululla pienempiinkin rakennustöihin puitesopimuksen mukaisesti. Solmittava sopimus on määräaikainen kahdeksi vuodeksi, jonka jälkeen sopimusta voidaan tilaajan päätöksellä jatkaa alkuperäisin ehdoin enintään kahden (2) vuoden ajalle. Puitejärjestelyssä mukana olevalla palveluntuottajalla on mahdollisuus esittää hinnankorotustoivomus ennen mahdollisen optiokauden alkua. Hinnankorotuksen tulee perustua todellisten kustannusten nousuun ja toivomus tulee esittää kirjallisena kolme kuukautta ennen optiokauden alkua. Sopimuskausi alkaa sopimuksessa määriteltynä aikana. Tavoitteena on, että sopimus alkaa 1.1.2027. Sopimus tullaan solmimaan useamman Palveluntuottajan kanssa (puitejärjestely). Sopimus ei tule sisältämään määräostovelvoitetta. Tilaajan arvio hankinnan laajuudesta on noin 60 000 € (alv 0 %) / vuosi. Tämä on arvio, eikä sido tilaajaa mihinkään. Tarjous tulee tehdä arvonlisäverottomilla tuntihinnoilla. Tuntihinnan tulee sisältää työmaan yleis- ja yhteiskulut (esimerkiksi työnjohto, työkalukorvaus, matkakulut, päivärahat, palkkojen sivukulut jne.). Työssä tarvittavien työvälineiksi katsottavat tarvikkeet (taskulamput, paristot ja polttimot) sekä työssä käytettävien koneiden ja laitteiden tulee sisältyä myös tuntihintoihin. Lisäksi tarjouksessa tulee huomioida, että telineet ja nostokalusto kuuluvat Palveluntuottajan huolehdittavaksi. Telineistä ja nostokalustosta voidaan erikseen laskuttaa tilaajaa. Näiden hinnoittelusta tulee sopia tilaajan kanssa ennen työn aloittamista. Laskujen liitteenä täytyy olla tarvikkeiden ostolaskut. Sopimukseen kuuluvat seuraavat kokonaisuudet: - Rakennusmies - Maalari/pintakäsittelijä Lisäksi kysytään rakennusluvan alaisten töiden vastaavan työnjohtajan tuntihintaa, mutta se ei vaikuta tarjousvertailuun. Toimeksiantojen jakaminen puitejärjestelyn aikana: Puitejärjestelyyn valitaan viisi (5) toimittajaa. Yksittäiset rakennusurakat, joiden ennakoitu arvo ylittää 150 000 € (alv 0 %), kilpailutetaan puitejärjestelyyn valittujen toimittajien kesken erillisellä kevennetyllä kilpailutuksella (minikilpailutus). Urakat, joiden ennakoitu arvo on enintään 150 000 € (alv 0 %), voidaan tilata suoraan puitejärjestelyyn valitulta toimittajalta ilman minikilpailutusta tai hankintayksikkö voi harkintansa mukaan järjestää myös näistä hankinnoista minikilpailutuksen puitejärjestelytoimittajien kesken. Mikäli hankinta tehdään ilman minikilpailutusta, toimittajan valinnassa voidaan huomioida yksi tai useampi seuraavista perusteista: • toimittajan käytettävissä olevat resurssit ja kyky aloittaa työ hankintayksikön edellyttämässä aikataulussa; • hankinnan kiireellisyys; • aikaisemmin samassa kohteessa tai kiinteistössä toteutettujen töiden tarkoituksenmukainen jatkaminen; • hankinnan kokonaistaloudellinen tarkoituksenmukaisuus hankintayksikön näkökulmasta.,

·        Transmission automatique adaptée aux manœuvres de déneigement

·        Une lame à neige de qualité supérieure

title: Registre cantonal des personnes pour la communauté GERES
description:
La communauté GERES, qui regroupe 16 cantons suisses, exploite depuis plus de quinze ans le logiciel spécialisé GERES. Il s’agit d’une solution d’harmonisation des registres destinée aux cantons, qui permet un échange de données sécurisé et standardisé entre les registres des personnes physiques, les applications spécialisées et les différentes unités administratives.

La base technologique du logiciel existant est obsolète et sa poursuite n’est plus pertinente.

L'objectif de l'appel d'offres est de définir et d'acquérir, dans le cadre d'un projet d'acquisition commun, une solution de registre pérenne, sécurisée et économiquement viable (registre cantonal des personnes) (développement sur mesure ou solution existante). Celle-ci doit renforcer la collaboration entre les cantons, permettre des synergies dans l'exploitation et le développement continu, et répondre aux exigences élevées en matière de qualité et de sécurité dans le domaine de la gestion des registres.

La mission principale consiste à développer et à fournir le logiciel de base. Viendront ensuite la configuration et la mise en place échelonnées du logiciel de base dans les 16 cantons membres.

title: Elektriske renovasjonskjøretøy i flere delkontrakter
description: Bakgrunn Oppdragsgiver har behov for å anskaffe flere nye renovasjonskjøretøy som ledd i utskifting av eldre kjøretøy og for å dekke et økt kapasitetsbehov i renovasjonstjenesten. Anskaffelsen skal bidra til å sikre en driftssikker, fremtidsrettet og tilstrekkelig dimensjonert kjøretøypark for ulike innsamlings- og transportoppgaver. Behovet omfatter flere typer kjøretøy tilpasset ulike ruter og driftsoppgaver. Kjøretøyene skal kunne benyttes under varierende driftsforhold, og oppdragsgiver har derfor behov for leveranser som er egnet for ordinær renovasjonsdrift, inkludert tilhørende service- og oppfølgingsbehov. Alle kjøretøy som anskaffes, skal være elektriske. For å legge til rette for hensiktsmessig konkurranse, god markedstilpasning og effektiv kontraktsoppfølging, planlegges anskaffelsen delt inn i separate delkontrakter per kjøretøytype. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Anskaffelsen gjelder komplett leveranse av elektriske renovasjonskjøretøy i flere kategorier. Leveransen omfatter både standard renovasjonskjøretøy og spesialkjøretøy for ulike renovasjons- og transportformål, herunder kjøretøy med blant annet automatlift, flere kammer, krokløft, lift, kran og plan. Anskaffelsen er delt opp i 7 delkontrakter. Leverandør kan gi tilbud på én eller flere delkontrakter. Det er også anledning til å levere flere tilbud innenfor samme delkontrakt. Oppdragsgiver ønsker tilbud på følgende kjøretøy: 9 stk. 6x2 renovasjonskjøretøy, 1-kammer med automatlift 4 stk. 4x2 renovasjonskjøretøy, 1-kammer med kamlift 1 stk. 6x2 renovasjonskjøretøy, 2-kammer med kort akselavstand 1 stk. 6x2 liftdumper 1 stk. 6x2 krokløft 1 stk. 8x4 renovasjonskjøretøy med kran og vaskeanlegg 1 stk. 6x2 planbil med kran Leveransen skal være komplett og omfatte nødvendige kjøretøy med påbygg og relevant utrustning for de aktuelle bruksområdene. I tillegg skal serviceavtale, tilgang til reservedeler og telematikk inngå. Nærmere krav til ytelse, tekniske spesifikasjoner, funksjonalitet og kontraktsstruktur vil fremgå av konkurransegrunnlaget og tilhørende kravspesifikasjon.

title: Analyse av sammenslåing av videregående skoler
description: Bakgrunn Rogaland fylkeskommune har fått en politisk bestilling om å utrede sammenslåing av videregående skoler. Formålet er å vurdere tiltak som kan redusere administrative kostnader, styrke ressursutnyttelsen og gi et bedre grunnlag for framtidig organisering av skoleområdet. Fylkesdirektøren vurderer samtidig alternativer uten sammenslåing av skoler, men hvor merkantile ressurser og lærerressurser kan brukes, og valgemner kan tas på tvers av skolene. Det skal også vurderes andre standardiseringer for å kunne bruke ressurser bedre på tvers av skoler Fylkeskommunen driver 24 videregående skoler, to skolesentre og Nettskolen. Skolene varierer i størrelse, profil og geografisk plassering. Med administrativ sammenslåing menes organisatoriske løsninger der to eller flere skoler samordnes administrativt, uten at dette nødvendigvis innebærer endringer i fysisk lokalisering eller elevenes opplæringstilbud. Det er tidligere gjennomført en overordnet analyse av temaet. Rogaland fylkeskommune har nå behov for en mer konkret og beslutningsrelevant utredning som identifiserer aktuelle sammenslåingsalternativer og belyser økonomiske, organisatoriske og samfunnsmessige konsekvenser. Analysen skal gi et robust grunnlag for videre politisk behandling, med tydelige vurderinger av gevinster, kostnader, risiko og gjennomførbarhet. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Oppdraget gjelder levering av konsulenttjenester for analyse av administrativ sammenslåing av videregående skoler i Rogaland. Leveransen skal omfatte en faglig fundert vurdering av hvilke skoler eller skolemiljøer som er aktuelle for administrativ sammenslåing, og en nærmere analyse av de alternativene som vurderes som mest relevante. Oppdraget skal gjennomføres i to hovedtrinn. Først skal leverandøren identifisere og begrunne aktuelle sammenslåingsalternativer basert på blant annet skolestruktur, organisatorisk gjennomførbarhet og potensial for administrativ effektivisering. Deretter skal leverandøren gjennomføre konsekvensanalyser av de alternativene som velges ut for videre vurdering. Analysen skal belyse økonomiske forhold, konsekvenser for elever og ansatte, virkninger for samfunn og øvrige interessenter samt sentrale risikoforhold. Oppdraget skal også omfatte strukturert involvering av relevante interessenter, herunder skoleledelse, tillitsvalgte og administrasjon, slik at innspill dokumenteres og inngår i vurderingene. Elevperspektivet skal belyses på en egnet måte. Konsulent skal også vurdere om bruk av resurser på tvers av skolene (uten sammenslåing) kan være et hensiktsmessig alternativ. I denne vurderingen må man se på bruken av merkantile ressurser, lærerressurser og muligheten for at elevene kan ta valgemner på tvers av skolene. Det skal også vurderes andre standardiseringer for å kunne bruke ressurser bedre på tvers av skoler Det forventes at leverandøren benytter både kvantitative og kvalitative metoder, og leverer rapporter som gir oppdragsgiver et tydelig, etterprøvbart og handlingsrettet beslutningsgrunnlag. Leveransen skal munne ut i anbefalte sammenslåingsalternativer med vurdering av fordeler, ulemper, usikkerhet og mulige gjennomføringstiltak.

title: Netherlands – Public transport services by railways – Concessie Zutphen-Hengelo-Oldenzaal 2028-2032
description: De Concessie Zutphen-Hengelo-Oldenzaal start op 10 december 2028 en kent een looptijd van 4 jaar en kan maximaal twee keer met één jaar worden verlengd. Deze Concessie geldt als een overbruggingsconcessie. Gedurende de looptijd van de Concessie beoogt de Concessieverlener elektrificatie van het traject te realiseren. Ten tijde van de initiële publicatie van dit Beschrijvend document voert ProRail hiervoor een planuitwerking uit. Na afloop van de Concessie beoogt de Concessieverlener in een opvolgende concessie elektrische Treinen in te zetten. De Gedeputeerde Staten van Overijssel en Gelderland zijn (ieder voor haar grondgebied) verantwoordelijk voor de Concessie Zutphen-Hengelo-Oldenzaal. Deze Concessie wordt aanbesteed middels een openbare Europese procedure. De Provincie Overijssel zal als penvoerder optreden gedurende de aanbestedingsprocedure. Zie aanbestedingsstukken.

title: France – Laboratory services – Accord-Cadre pour des prestations d’appuis aux activités des groupes et d’assistances aux travaux de laboratoire​ pour la DT TEGG
description: Ce marché porte sur des accords cadre pour des prestations d’appuis aux activités des groupes et d’assistances aux travaux de laboratoire pour la DT TEGG, comportant 3 lots techniques : - Lot 1 : Appuis aux activités des groupes et d'assistance aux travaux de laboratoire ​(maitrise des opérations de Génie Civil, compétences en préparation d'essais et bancs d'essai, connaissance des environnements ATEX, rédaction et mise en oeuvre de modes opératoires, compétences en logistique et gestion d'entrepôt...) - Lot 2 : Appui technique aux essais et suivis d'application dans les groupes laboratoire de TEGG​ (génie civil : applications de peintures, mastics et résines; maitrise des exigences COFRAC, réalisation et suivi des essais techniques; connaissance des zones ATEX, rédaction de modes opératoires et de procès-verbaux d'essais...) - Lot 3 : Prestations intellectuelles et d'appui technique et organisation à l'instruction des dossiers de qualification/admission des peintures, revêtements et calfeutrement pour le groupe MOE du laboratoire TEGG.​ (génie civil : applications et suivis de peintures, mastics et résines; maitrise des exigences COFRAC; connaissance des zones ATEX; rédaction de modes opératoires et de procès-verbaux d'essais...) Durée du marché : 8 ans (4 ans fermes + 4 x1 an optionnel) Marché mono-attributaire (1 attributaire par lot) : pour tous les lots, les prestations s’effectuent majoritairement sur le site de TEGG, à l’exception de certaines prestations détaillées et validées dans le CCTP, qui seront effectuées sur d’autres sites partenaires.​

title: Netherlands – Job search services – Europese SAS-procedure Re-integratietrajecten Participatiewet
description: Dit is de Europese SAS-procedure voor Re-integratietrajecten Participatiewet. De procedure wordt als volgt ingericht. Aanbestedende dienst start met een zogenoemde selectiefase. Geïnteresseerde aanbieders kunnen zich aanmelden voor deze selectiefase. In deze selectiefase spreken we dan ook nog niet van een inschrijver, maar van een gegadigde en/of aanmelder. Aanbestedende dienst selecteert in de selectiefase (maximaal) 5 aanbieders per perceel. Hoe de percelen zijn ingericht, welke eisen gelden in de selectiefase en hoe de selectie plaatsvindt leest u in de aanbestedingsdocumenten, specifiek de Selectieleidraad Deel A terug. Aanbestedende dienst nodigt de geselecteerde aanbieders vervolgens uit om een inschrijving te doen welke beoordeeld wordt in de opvolgende niet-openbare fase. De onderliggende opdracht betreft de inzet van externe re‑integratiedienstverlening voor inwoners van de gemeente Eindhoven die ondersteuning nodig hebben op weg naar duurzame participatie of betaald werk. De dienstverlening wordt ingekocht in drie samenhangende trajectsoorten: - Perceel 1: Arbeidsactivering; - Perceel 2: Arbeidstoeleiding inclusief nazorg; - Perceel 3: Arbeidsactivering specifiek voor jongeren in de leeftijd 16-18 jaar.

title: E-Waste Collection Events
description: INTRODUCTION Battelle Energy Alliance LLC (BEA), the Management and Operating Contractor of the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) owned Idaho National Laboratory (INL), is seeking Expressions of Interest (EOI) from qualified recyclers capable of organizing residential electronic waste (e-waste) collection events in states without e-waste recycling regulation (i.e., nonregulated states) to support INL�s research and operational mission. This service is essential for raising awareness, increasing collection volumes and verifying whether successful collection methods from a regulated state can be applied to a nonregulated state with comparable results. Eligible states for this work include Alabama, Alaska, Arizona, Arkansas, Colorado, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Idaho (except eastern and southeastern region), Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Mississippi, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Dakota, Ohio, South Dakota, Tennessee and Wyoming. BACKGROUND BEA is the Management and Operating Contractor for the DOE located at INL. INL is a DOE national laboratory dedicated to nuclear energy, national security and advanced energy innovation. A BEA research team has the lead role on the DOE project titled, �Comparing Strategies to Collect Battery-Containing Devices in States with and without Electronics Recycling Laws.� The proposed service will operate to support this project through Sept. 30, 2027. In the first two years of this project, project teams organized collection events in New York and Idaho. New York is as urban area with established e-waste regulations, and Idaho is a rural area without such requirements. By applying successful collection methods from New York to southeastern Idaho, we observed similar success across 20 e-waste collection events. To further validate these results, we are seeking opportunities to apply our methods in other nonregulated states by organizing six to nine e-waste collection events. SCOPE OF WORK Responding organizations must be capable of delivering the following services: Provide existing status; compile data from existing residential collection activities related to seasonal trends, locations and e-waste types. Organize collection events at new locations in nonregulated states, with each participating organization conducting at least two to three collection events before September 2027. Arrange advertisements on multiple channels to broadcast new collection events and raise awareness about battery-containing e-waste recycling. Provide collection event data including number of participants and quantities of collected e-waste by type PROCESS This EOI is the first step in identifying interested and qualified vendors for future solicitation. Responses may be used to inform the development of a formal solicitation list. Selected vendors may be invited to participate in a Request for Proposal process for award consideration. SUBMITTAL REQUIREMENTS Interested vendors should submit an EOI that includes the following: Organization information: Organization name, address, organization type, scope of operations, number of employees and primary point of contact. Existing e-waste collection access: Describe existing e-waste collection events, permanent drop-off locations or other collection options available in the proposed service area. Program interest and expected outcomes: Explain why your organization wants to participate in this project and what outcomes you expect to achieve. Service area and target participants: Identify the cities, counties, or communities that will be served by the proposed e-waste collection activities. Community need: Describe the primary e-waste management challenges or unmet needs in the proposed service area. Collection plan: Describe the proposed e-waste collection activities for the program year (by Sept. 1, 2027). Provide the anticipated number of collection events and proposed cities, counties, or collection locations. Provide communication strategies (i.e. social media, mail, news, flyers, etc.) to raise awareness and promote collection events. Downstream e-waste management: Identify who will transport, receive, recycle, process, or otherwise manage the collected e-waste. Recycler/processor qualifications: Identify relevant certifications or qualifications of the entities handling collected e-waste, such as R2, e-Stewards, or other applicable certifications. Partnership with local nonprofit organizations or local authorities: Specify whether the proposed e-waste collection activities involve collaboration with local nonprofit organizations or governmental authorities. Deadline for submission: Nov. 13, 2026 (date subject to change) Submit to: Chase.Egbert@inl.gov Technical Point of Contact: ThiThuyTien.Le@inl.gov Only select respondents, as determined by BEA, will receive an invitation to participate in the anticipated Request for Proposal solicitation. PROPRIETARY INFORMATION Because information received in response to this EOI may be business sensitive or proprietary to the responding party, respondents must mark information in their responses accordingly.

title: USCG Response Boat Small Third Generation (RB-S III)
description: The United States Coast Guard (USCG) is issuing Request for Proposals (RFP) No. 70Z02326R93250001 for the Response Boat Small Third Generation (RB-S III). The Government intends to award up to four (4) Indefinite-Delivery, Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) contracts for the design, production, testing, delivery, and related supplies and services for the RB-S III and associated purpose-built trailers in accordance with the solicitation. The acquisition will recapitalize the aging fleet of 29-foot RB-S II platforms and includes boats, trailers, logistics support, technical documentation, configuration management, supply support, and other related requirements identified in the solicitation. The solicitation and publicly releasable supporting documents are provided below under the Attachments/Links section of this notice. Offerors are responsible for reviewing the solicitation, all applicable attachments, and any subsequent amendments in their entirety. The anticipated IDIQ ordering period is ten (10) years, consisting of a two (2) year base ordering period and one eight (8) year option ordering period. Two-Phase Acquisition and Evaluation Process This solicitation uses a two-phase competitive acquisition and down-select process. Phase I: The Government will evaluate written proposals under the following factors in accordance with Section M of the solicitation: Factor I � Mission Effectiveness (Non-Price) Factor II � Production and Management (Non-Price) Factor III � Price Following the Phase I evaluation and best-value tradeoff, the Government may select up to four (4) Offerors for award of IDIQ contracts. Each Phase I awardee will receive an initial Delivery Order satisfying the contract minimum guarantee for the construction and delivery of one (1) demonstrator boat and trailer for participation in Phase II. Phase II: Phase I awardees will participate in a Government-conducted In-Water Demonstration lasting up to 90 calendar days. Phase II will evaluate: Factor IV � In-Water Demonstration (Non-Price) Factor III � Price (carries forward from Phase I, not a new price evaluation) Phase II is an independent evaluation. Phase I evaluation results, other than carrying the price evaluation forward, will not influence the Phase II evaluation. The Technical Evaluation Team (TET) will use the In-Water Demonstration Report and documented personal observations during the In-Water Demonstration to conduct a comparative evaluation of how each demonstrator boat performed in comparison to the other demonstrator boats. The TET will document the specific technical advantages and disadvantages identified through the comparative evaluation under Factor IV. Following completion of Phase II, the Government will conduct a final best-value tradeoff evaluation and select one (1) IDIQ contractor to receive all subsequent production Delivery Orders for the remaining RB-S III boats. Price evaluations will remain unchanged from Phase I; no price revisions or updates will be permitted in Phase II. Proposal Submission Phase I proposals are due: 13 November 2026 at 1400 Eastern Time All proposal submissions shall be made in accordance with Section L of the solicitation. Phase I proposals must be submitted electronically through the Department of Defense Secure Access File Exchange (DoD SAFE). In accordance with Section L.3(b), Offerors shall email the Contracting Officer and Contract Specialist no later than five (5) working days prior to the proposal due date to request a DoD SAFE Drop-Off Request. Questions and Requests for Clarification Questions shall be submitted in accordance with Section L no later than: 14 October 2026 at 1400 Eastern Time Questions received after this date may not be answered. Government responses may be issued through solicitation questions and answers and/or formal solicitation amendment, as appropriate. Solicitation Documents and Restricted GFI See the Attachments/Links section below for the solicitation and publicly releasable supporting documents associated with this RFP. Certain Government Furnished Information identified in Section J is authorized under Distribution Statement C and will not be publicly posted to SAM.gov. Authorized Offerors requiring access to these documents shall submit a written request by email to the Contracting Officer and Contract Specialist. Following verification of the requester�s authorization to receive the material, the Government will transmit the applicable documents through DoD SAFE.

title: Phase 2 Construct Arabian Leopard Exhibit at the National Zoological Park
description: The Smithsonian Institution is seeking offers to construct Phase 2 - Habitats & Animal Care Building for the Arabian Leopard Facility (ALF) at the Smithsonian National Zoological Park, located at 3001 Connecticut Ave NW, Washington, DC 20008, as described herein and the Contract Documents, including, without limitation, in the Specifications and Drawings for SF Project No. 2533105 both dated June 14, 2026. All of the requirements which the successful Offeror must meet concerning this project are set forth in detail in the solicitation Documents included with this Request for Proposal. Upon the receipt of Technical and Cost Proposals and the selection of a successful Offeror, the Smithsonian Institution will execute a Firm Fixed Price construction contract. The Smithsonian currently estimates that the fixed price for the entire project will exceed $10 Million. The Work includes but is not limited to Construction Services for Phase 2 � Habitats and Animal Care Building. This solicitation is for Phase 2 � Habitats and Animal Care Building only. Successful offerors must be capable of performing all work described and contemplated by this solicitation. Critical Elements of the Work: The successful Contractor shall be experienced and fully qualified with critical elements of the project, as listed, but not limited to, the items below: Working within an occupied, historic campus active with public, staff and animals Coordination of specialty trades within a small site footprint Coordination and installation of specialty animal doors, transfer systems and manually operated remote door controls. Coordination and installation of radiant flooring Coordination and installation of animal containment fencing, mesh and transfer chutes Coordination and installation of shotcrete faux rock and faux trees Mitigation of sound and vibration during construction so as not to harm animals in adjacent habitats Coordination of construction activities with Zoo operations to align with feeding schedules, DC zoning community noise regulations, Zoo hours, known and unknown animal welfare issues, veterinary care, and public events Procedures and documentation to ensure compliance with the established LEED building criteria Use of Building Information Modeling (BIM). The following firms were prequalified in solicitation 33330226FT0010005 and are the only firms from which offers will be accepted: Grunley 15020 Shady Grove Road, Suite 500 Rockville, MD 20850 Consigli 1825 K Street, Suite 1000 Washington, DC 20006 The Whiting-Turner Contracting Company 4600 River Road, Suite 200 College Park, MD 20737 PRE-BID TOUR OF THE SITE The Pre-proposal meeting is scheduled for Friday, September 18, 2026, at 9:00 AM Eastern Time. REQUEST FOR CLARIFICATIONS Itis requested that all questions be sent in no later than September 30, 2026. THE PROPOSAL DUE DATE IS FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 13, 2026, AT 3:00 PM EASTERN STANDARD TIME (EST). The subcontracting goals for this project are: 40% with small business concerns. Davis Bacon Building Wage Determination DC20260002 and DC20260001 shall apply. The Period of Performance for the Base Contract is 578 calendar days from the date of Notice to Proceed.

description: Динамичната система за покупки (ДСП) се създава за доставка на различни видове химикали и реактиви за нуждите на „Специализирана болница за активно лечение на хематологични заболявания” ЕАД (СБАЛХЗ ЕАД). Посочените количества в Техническата спецификация са прогнозни и не пораждат задължения за Възложителя да ги възложи в прогнозния обем. Фактическото изпълнение на обществената поръчка се определя на базата прием на пациенти и прогнозата на СБАЛХЗ ЕАД за необходимите на лечебното заведение химикали и реактиви. Срокът на ДСП е 24 (двадесет и четири) месеца. ДСП се провежда на два етапа. ПЪРВИ ЕТАП НА ДИНАМИЧНАТА СИСТЕМА ЗА ПОКУПКИ – СЪБИРАНЕ НА ЗАЯВЛЕНИЯ ЗА УЧАСТИЕ Квалифициране на доставчиците (допускане на доставчиците до системата). На този етап се събират заявления за участие. Заявленията за участие /ЕЕДОП/ съдържат информация относно личното състояние на кандидатите и критериите за подбор.

title: CPE CBRND Seeking Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) of Silicon Dioxide (SiO2) on Aluminum Flakes for Screening Obscuration Module - Multispectral (SOM-M)
description: 1.0 Disclaimer This Request for Information (RFI) is issued solely for information and planning purposes. It does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP) or a promise to issue an RFP in the future. This RFI does not commit the U.S. Government (USG) to contract for any supply or service whatsoever. Furthermore, the USG will not accept unsolicited proposals in response to this RFI. Responders are advised that the USG will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this RFI. All costs associated with responding to this RFI will be solely at the interested party�s expense. The information gathered by this RFI will be shared with relevant interested USG parties to help inform future development and procurement efforts. 2.0 Background The Joint Product Manager for CBRN Layered Effects is responsible for enabling and enhancing the survivability of our Joint Warfighters so they can fight and win across all domains in a CBRN-contested environment. As the acquisition leader in mobile analytics, our portfolio provides transformative solutions � including advanced reconnaissance systems, sensors, and mobile analytical laboratories � that ensure our military is safeguarded against chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear threats. To support this mission, the USG is pursuing the Screening Obscuration Module - Multispectral (SOM-M) program, which is envisioned as a modular, man-portable, ground-emplaced obscuration and screening system designed to produce a multispectral obscurant cloud for both mounted and dismounted use. In support of the SOM-M program, the USG is issuing this Request for Information (RFI) to identify alternative, cost-effective commercial manufacturing options for critical, novel bispectral obscurant material. The technical requirements for this capability are detailed in Section 4.0 of this document. 3.0 Purpose The purpose of this RFI is to survey industry capabilities and identify alternative commercial manufacturing options for a novel bispectral obscurant material. Specifically, the USG seeks to identify manufacturers capable of performing high-volume Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) of Silicon Dioxide (SiO2) onto Aluminum Flakes at a commercial scale, and to assess industry readiness to support a potential Army-funded manufacturing maturation project aimed at reducing sustainment costs. 4.0 Technical Requirements Interested parties must demonstrate capabilities or conceptual pathways to meet the following production and material requirements: Base Material & Size: Aluminum Flake sized at 2 � 4 microns. Coating Process & Material: Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) of Silicon Dioxide (SiO2) onto the aluminum flakes. Target Production Volume: Scalable to large commercial quantities, ranging from hundreds of pounds (lbs) to tons. Cost Efficiency: Proposed alternative manufacturing options must significantly reduce current manufacturing protocol costs to ensure long-term sustainment capability for the military services. 5.0 Requested Information Interested parties are requested to respond to this RFI providing a white paper including technical insights on the manufacturing feasibility, cost-effectiveness, and scalability of the proposed Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) process. Ideal responses will include the following elements: Manufacturing/Production Approach: A comprehensive overview of the proposed methodology to achieve the PVD coating of Silicon Dioxide (SiO2) on Aluminum Flakes (2 � 4 microns). This should include details on the facility scale, equipment, and proposed lead times based on the scale of material produced. Cost Projections & Scale: Estimated cost profiles and projected cost-reduction curves when scaling production from hundreds of pounds to tons, demonstrating how the approach achieves a sustainable cost profile for long term acquisition. Maturity, Capacity, & Risks: An assessment of current facility readiness, current and potential production capacity, and identified technical and manufacturing challenges or risk factors associated with scaling this specific PVD coating process. Company Information & Past Performance: A brief summary of relevant company experience, facility capabilities, or prior similar material coating efforts. 6.0 Submission Requirements All submissions must be electronic and adhere to the following formatting and content rules: Page Limit: All responses shall be no longer than five (5) pages. Formatting: Standard 8.5 x 11-inch pages, with font size no smaller than 10-point. Company Information: Include official company name, address, telephone number, website, and business type (large/small business classification), CAGE Code. Point of Contact: Provide the name, title, telephone number, and email address of the authorized company representative. 7.0 Submission Guidance Submission Deadline: Responses are requested no later than 5 PM EST Friday, 13 November 2026. Submissions and/or questions should be emailed directly to the following point of contact: Emily McGill, Contract Specialist, emily.c.mcgill.civ@army.mil Samantha Degele, Contracting Officer, samantha.l.degele.civ@army.mil

title: Copy Flawil District Heating – Central Energy Plant BKP 246: Heat Pump System using R-717 (Ammonia)
description:
The Technische Betriebe Flawil (TBF) are planning a district heating network. Treated wastewater from the Flawil–Degersheim–Gossau Wastewater Association (AVFDG) will be used as the heat source for heat generation by means of heat pumps. The new energy centre will be constructed above the existing operations building at the Oberglatt wastewater treatment plant. The district heating network will supply heat to customers substations, where it can be used for space heating and domestic hot water production. An intelligent control and monitoring system will manage and supervise the entire network, from heat generation through to heat delivery.


The present tender document covers BKP 246 – Heat Pump System R-717 (Ammonia) for the energy centre.

title: Planification et conception SIA 32-53 du programme de remplacement des chaînes
description:
Certaines pièces des isolateurs du réseau de Swissgrid ont atteint leur durée de vie utile et doivent être remplacées. De plus, certains pylônes sont encore équipés de chaînes simples et doivent être équipés de chaînes doubles. C'est dans ce contexte qu'un projet visant à remplacer les chaînes à l'échelle nationale a été lancé.


Dans un premier temps, l’avant-projet (conforme à la SIA 31) a été réalisé afin d’obtenir une vue d’ensemble complète des chaînes à remplacer. Ces résultats étant désormais disponibles, le projet passe à la phase de conception.


Afin de poursuivre la planification et la coordination de ce projet, le présent appel d'offres vise à recruter des planificateur spécialisés dans la construction de lignes pour les phases SIA 32 à 53 dans les différentes régions (Est, Centre et Ouest). Outre l'ensemble des prestations spécifiques à leur domaine de compétence, ceux-ci assumeront également la supervision et la coordination globales de tous les domaines spécialisés impliqués, y compris les interfaces, en tant que responsables généraux au sens de la norme SIA 103.


Les éléments suivants doivent être organisés par le planifcateur:


  • Direction et coordination de tous les domaines spécialisés impliqués, y compris les interfaces (direction générale)
  • Ingénierie et planification dans le projet partiel - Infrastructure des lignes
  • Modélisation dans PLS-CADD et TOWER
  • Direction des travaux (facultatif)


Les éléments suivants sont organisés par le donneur d'ordre:


  • Coordination globale BIM côté mandant
  • Tiers pour l'assistance du maître d'ouvrage (AMO)
  • Tiers pour l'étude de projet et la planification dans le projet partiel - Planification environnementale
  • Tiers pour l'étude de projet et la planification dans le projet partiel - Acquisition de droits
  • Tiers pour la réception des travaux de montage


Un contrat d'une durée de 5 ans sera conclu avec les adjudicataires de chaque lot. Ces contrats serviront de base aux commandes régionales individuelles destinées au remplacement des chaînes. Il n'y a qu'un seul adjudicataire par lot ; c'est pourquoi ces commandes individuelles doivent être considérées comme des commandes directes.


Pour plus de détails sur l'étendue des prestations, veuillez vous reporter aux documents C100 et C101.

title: Quantum Benchmarking Initiative (QBI) 2026 Announcement
description: The Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) seeks innovative approaches to address challenges related to quantum computing. The Quantum Benchmarking Initiative (QBI) aims to examine approaches for constructing a utility-scale fault-tolerant quantum computer and computational workflows that include quantum compute steps. Proposed research should investigate approaches that enable revolutionary advances in design, engineering, test, and evaluation of such systems. Specifically excluded is research that primarily results in evolutionary improvements to the existing state of practice. To rapidly capitalize on new opportunities, DARPA announces the QBI 2026 opportunity, which seeks specific solutions to targeted challenges related to developing utility-scale quantum computers, as defined in specific QBI topic (QBIT) calls. Each QBIT will (1) outline specific details regarding the research topic of interest and (2) provide proposal and submission instructions, including the due date for proposal submission, in addition to those outlined in this PA. Proposals must only be submitted in response to a QBIT. Proposals submitted directly to this PA will not be considered.

Funding ID: F36C134-26-0000073 Nature and/or Description of the Action Being Approved: Firm-fixed price contract for expert witness and consulting services for defending a contract dispute pending Civilian Board of Contract Appeals (CBCA) where expert services for a medical recovery audit contract is needed. Description of Supplies/Services Required to Meet the Agency s Needs: VA OGC has a new requirement for expert witness litigation support services from XXXX XXXXXX, of LitCon Group, LLC in support of ongoing litigation of CBCA Claims 7718, 8054 and 8056, Alexander CPA, PLLC v Department of Veterans Affairs. The expert witness shall perform the following services: Review and analyze the Appellant's expert report(s) and the supporting data, methodologies, and assumptions relied upon, including any damages model and any opinions concerning industry-standard practices; Review relevant contract documentation, including the contract and its Performance Work Statement, the contingency-fee payment structure, the task order/ordering mechanism, the Feasibility Assessment Report requirements, claim denial and compliant-payment data, and applicable correspondence and administrative record materials provided by VA counsel; Evaluate the reliability and validity of the opposing expert's damages calculations, including the reasonableness of recovery projections derived from collected/closed claim populations, treatment of the contingency-fee model, assumptions regarding recoverable amounts, causation linking alleged VA conduct to claimed losses, and any failure to account for contract terms limiting or conditioning recovery (e.g., task-order issuance contingent on feasibility results, exclusions of certain claim categories, refund-request offsets, and cessation of payment six months after task order expiration); Prepare a written rebuttal report stating the expert's opinions, the bases and reasons for them, the facts and data considered, and the expert's qualifications, consistent with the standards applicable to expert reports before the CBCA; Provide deposition and hearing testimony as required and prepare for such testimony; Assist with VA s preparation for the deposition of Appellant s expert and assistance with VA s trial preparation; Assist with VA s preparation for, and attendance at, ADR, should one be conducted; and Consult with VA counsel throughout the engagement and respond to follow-up analytical requests as needed. title: High-Capacity Hydrogen and Hydrogen Isotope Getters
description: Even small amounts of hydrogen can damage sensitive equipment over time. As hydrogen accumulates inside sealed environments, it can corrode metals, weaken structural materials, degrade electronic components, and, in some applications, create explosion hazards. Preventing that buildup is essential for maintaining the reliability and safety of many high-value systems. Hydrogen getters are materials built into sealed devices and systems to remove hydrogen before it can accumulate. Like a moisture absorber, they remove an unwanted gas. Instead of trapping water, however, they chemically react with hydrogen and lock it away permanently. Depending on the application, a getter may take the form of a pellet, coating, thin film, powder, or printable material. Many commercially available getters rely on zirconium-based materials that offer limited hydrogen storage capacity, require activation before use, or operate effectively only within a narrow temperature range. Some also depend on costly vacuum-deposition manufacturing processes that limit design flexibility. Los Alamos researchers have developed a new class of hydrogen getters designed to overcome these limitations. The materials capture hydrogen and its isotopes, including deuterium and tritium, across a broad range of operating conditions without requiring activation while offering significantly higher storage capacity and greater flexibility for manufacturing and product integration. Value Proposition Hydrogen can quietly build up inside sealed devices and industrial systems, shortening equipment life and creating safety risks. Los Alamos National Laboratory has developed a new class of high-capacity hydrogen getters that permanently remove hydrogen before it causes damage. Compared with conventional getters, this technology stores more hydrogen, operates across a wider range of conditions, and can be manufactured in multiple forms for easy integration into commercial products. Hydrogen uptake rate decreases as getter materials fill with hydrogen. Compared with a conventional getter (brown), the LANL high-capacity getter (green) maintains rapid hydrogen capture over a much larger storage capacity. Advantages Stores significantly more hydrogen than many conventional getter materials. Permanently removes hydrogen, improving long-term reliability in sealed systems. Operates across a broad temperature range without activation. Captures hydrogen even at pressures well below atmospheric levels. Selectively removes hydrogen in mixed-gas environments. Hydrogen uptake rates can be tailored to specific applications. Compatible with polymers and available as films, coatings, pellets, powders, strands, and printable pastes for flexible product integration. Reduces projected material and manufacturing costs compared with many zirconium-based getter technologies. Scalable manufacturing supports applications ranging from miniature electronics to large industrial systems. Technology Description The getter materials chemically react with hydrogen and its isotopes to form stable compounds that permanently lock the hydrogen inside the material, providing long-term protection for sealed devices and industrial equipment. The technology is based on a novel organic alkyne chemistry. Alkynes are carbon-containing molecules that readily react with hydrogen, allowing the material to store substantially more hydrogen than many conventional getter systems. Unlike many commercial getters, these materials operate without activation and continue to perform across a broad temperature range. They also selectively capture hydrogen in the presence of gases such as helium, nitrogen, argon, and methane, making them well suited for complex industrial and vacuum environments. The hydrogen capture rate can be tailored by adjusting the catalyst formulation for specific operating conditions. Hydrogen capture has also been demonstrated at pressures well below atmospheric conditions, expanding the range of potential applications. The materials are compatible with polymers and other common manufacturing materials, allowing them to be incorporated into films, coatings, pellets, powders, strands, adhesives, foams, and printable pastes. Market Applications Semiconductor and microelectronics packaging Hermetically sealed electronics Aerospace and defense Medical devices Nuclear material storage and processing Vacuum and gas purification systems Cryogenic equipment Oil and gas infrastructure Scientific instrumentation High-reliability industrial systems TRL 4 U.S. patent pending LA-UR-26-25730 LANL Tech Partnerships: Unlock the Innovative Potential Los Alamos National Laboratory offers a wide range of cutting-edge technologies and capabilities that may provide your company with a competitive edge in the market and unlock the innovative potential that can enhance, refine, and revolutionize your products. LANL�s licensing program focuses on moving inventions developed by our researchers to commercial innovations. Patented and patent pending inventions and copyrighted software are available to existing and start-up companies through exclusive and non-exclusive licensing agreements. For specific discussions, please contact licensing@lanl.gov. description: L'enquête suisse sur la population active (ESPA) est une enquête auprès des personnes qui est réalisée chaque année depuis 1991. Le but principal de l'ESPA est de fournir des données sur la structure de la population active et sur les comportements en matière d'activité professionnelle. Grâce à l'application stricte de définitions internationales, les données de la Suisse peuvent être comparées avec celles des pays de l'OCDE et de l'Union européenne. Depuis 2010, l'ESPA se déroule en continu. Enquête suisse sur la population active (ESPA) | Office fédéral de la statistique - OFS <https://www.bfs.admin.ch/bfs/fr/home/statistiques/travail-remuneration/enquetes/espa.html> L'appel d'offres porte sur les prestations suivantes : - Mise en œuvre l'ESPA en multimode (CAWI et CATI) selon les spécifications du « responsive web design », sur la base d'un questionnaire fourni par l’OFS. description: The 48th Contracting Squadron at Royal Air Force (RAF) Lakenheath, United Kingdom, seeks to identify qualified sources and cost-effective commercially practical solutions capable of providing reliable on-base parcel delivery services for RAF Lakenheath (RAFL), RAF Mildenhall (RAFM), and RAF Feltwell (RAFF) in the United Kingdom. Responses are not offers and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. The Government will not reimburse respondents for costs associated with preparation or submission of information in response to this RFI. * Background: Personnel who live or work on RAFL, RAFM, and RAF Feltwell receive both personal and official parcels from commercial delivery companies. The most common carriers, presently, have been DPD, DHL, Evri, FedEx, Parcelforce, UPS, Amazon, and Royal Mail. Royal Mail/Parcelforce are the only delivery entities that presently have installation access and deliver directly to the on-base addresses. Other commercial parcel delivery companies do not have installation access, creating challenges in completing delivery to the intended on-base residence or agency. The Government is exploring a recurring parcel delivery service capable of receiving or otherwise obtaining parcels from commercial carriers that do not have installation access and completing final delivery to the intended residence or agency on RAF Lakenheath, RAF Mildenhall, or RAF Feltwell. The Government seeks industry�s recommendations regarding the most efficient and economical means of accomplishing this outcome. Packages, after they are picked up by a neighbor, have an average dwell time of 2 weeks before the intended recipients of the packages become aware that a neighbor had received their package on their behalf. The Government is particularly interested in solutions that make use of existing commercial capabilities and minimize unnecessary Government-specific processes, facilities, equipment, or infrastructure. Primary Constraints: Installation access and funding will be the primary constraints and will be the biggest factors considered in developing the desired solution. Presently installation access for local nationals can take upwards of 7 months due to the MOD clearance/background check process. The government is not aware of any route to expedite the processing of packages. It has been observed that the delivery driver experiences a high level of turnover, unpredictable routes for drivers, and criminal records that prohibit access to the installation which affects the parcel delivery companies� ability to obtain installation access for their drivers. Drones are not permitted on or near these installations and should not be included in identified solutions. Government-provided escorts will not be available as an interim staffing or access solution. Respondents should consider these conditions when describing their proposed solution and should identify how they could achieve the required staffing and access capability within the anticipated transition period. Respondents should also identify cost-effective approaches for maintaining sufficient access-qualified staffing without unnecessarily increasing the number of personnel requiring installation access. Estimated Parcel Volume: Available information indicates that approximately 1,000 parcels per week are associated with RAF Lakenheath that are being coordinated for pick-up at businesses near the installation. Should a reliable delivery service be established, the volume of parcels is expected to at least triple. Comparable parcel-volume information is not currently available for RAFM or RAFF. The bases in order of highest estimated volume to lowest are as follows: RAFL, RAFF, RAFM. All quantities provided in this RFI are estimates for market research and planning purposes and should not be interpreted as guaranteed quantities or maximum quantities. Suggested solutions will need to be scalable to fluctuate as personnel to the bases fluctuate and parcel volume fluctuates. Respondents should identify how uncertainty and fluctuations in parcel volume would affect their recommended solution and pricing. Respondents are also encouraged to suggest a Contract Line Item Number (CLIN) structure best suited to their recommendation. Respondents are specifically encouraged to identify approaches that allow the service to scale efficiently as parcel volume changes without requiring the Government to pay for unnecessary excess capacity during lower-volume periods. Desired Outcome: The desired outcome is a reliable and cost-effective service capable of delivering eligible parcels from commercial delivery companies that do not have installation access to the residence or agency on the installation that ordered the item. The service would be expected to support RAFL, RAFM, and RAFF. All three installations are anticipated to be included from the very beginning of performance. The service would handle both personal and official parcels. Delivery service is expected seven days per week. For residential deliveries, parcels that do not require a recipient signature may be left at the recipient's door (or in a safe place designated by their delivery notes). The Government recognizes that commercial carriers may transfer parcels at different times throughout the day. Respondents should identify any operational assumptions, carrier coordination, cutoff times, or other conditions necessary to accomplish daily delivery. Solutions should not be disruptive, so the preference is to find a solution to deliver packages by 1700 each day ensuring no nighttime disruptions. If a requirement or assumption described in this RFI would have a significant impact on the cost, please identify the cost driver and recommend a less expensive alternative that would still provide reliable on-base parcel delivery. Commercial Carrier Coordination The Government has not established the required method for obtaining parcels from commercial carriers that lack installation access. Respondents should recommend solutions. If multiple solutions are available, you are encouraged to make multiple recommendations. The Government is interested in understanding how industry could establish effective and economical means of accepting, collecting, transferring, consolidating, or otherwise obtaining custody of eligible parcels from commercial delivery companies and subsequently completing final delivery to the appropriate on-base residence or agency. The Government has not determined whether an on-base facility, off-base facility, consolidation point, direct carrier transfer, existing commercial facility, existing delivery network, or another method represents the most effective solution. title: Technology Licensing Opportunity: Room-Temperature Electrochemical Metallization of Rare Earth Elements
description: Note: This is a technology licensing opportunity. No procurement, grants, or funding opportunities are associated with this notice. Room-Temperature Electrochemical Metallization of Rare Earth Elements A low-energy, low-hazard alternative to molten-salt electrolysis for sustainable REE production. Technology Summary This invention introduces a method to produce metallic rare earth elements (REEs) through room-temperature electrometallization in anhydrous electrolytes. By leveraging unique ion-pairing interactions, Lewis acid-base chemistry, and interfacial structuring, the system enables efficient REE reduction and stable metal formation without the extreme energy use or toxic byproducts of conventional fused salt electrolysis. Problem Addressed High cost & regulatory barriers: Current molten-salt electrolysis (600�1200 �C) generates toxic HF gas and rare earth fluoride waste, triggering costly EPA and OSHA compliance requirements. Environmental impact: Legacy processes produce hazardous waste with long-term contamination risks, leading to industry abandonment in North America. Supply chain dependence: Metallic REEs are only produced at scale in China, creating vulnerabilities for U.S. manufacturers and defense applications. Solution The invention replaces high-temperature fused salt electrolysis with an ambient-temperature electrochemical process. The approach integrates three synergistic innovations: Tuned electrolyte nucleophilicity � enabling more efficient reduction pathways. Lewis acid-base coordination control � stabilizing the ligand environment during deposition. Interfacial electrochemical structuring � improving reaction kinetics and metal stability. This combination allows REE electrodeposition at room temperature, reducing both energy demand and hazardous byproduct formation. This invention enables dual functionality, electrodeposition and (in-situ) electrorefining. Key Advantages Lower energy consumption � eliminates the need for 600�1200 �C molten salt processes. Reduced environmental liabilities � avoids HF gas emissions and toxic fluoride salt accumulation. Safer operations � circumvents EPA and RCRA compliance barriers tied to FSE. Domestic supply potential � enables North American REE production for critical industries. Scalable platform � adaptable to multiple REEs including neodymium, samarium, dysprosium, and terbium. Market Applications Permanent magnets � essential for EV traction motors, wind turbines, and energy-efficient refrigeration. Defense systems � critical components for satellites, communication devices, and advanced weapons. Lightweight alloys � enhancing aerospace and automotive materials. Electronics � miniaturized devices requiring REE-based components. Battery technologies � advanced REE-containing chemistries for high-performance storage.

title: Netherlands – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Brokerdienstverlening Inhuur MIRT-projecten
description: De Gemeente Den Haag werkt, in samenwerking met andere overheden en publieke organisaties, aan verschillende grootschalige infrastructurele projecten die onderdeel uitmaken van het Meerjarenprogramma Infrastructuur, Ruimte en Transport (MIRT). Binnen deze projecten treedt de Gemeente Den Haag als penvoerder op en is daarmee verantwoordelijk voor het aanbesteden en contracteren van benodigde diensten namens de betrokken samenwerkingspartners. De voorbereiding en uitvoering van deze projecten vraagt om de inzet van tijdelijke professionals met specifieke kennis en ervaring op het gebied van complexe infrastructurele projecten. De benodigde expertise bevindt zich met name binnen de disciplines projectmanagement, contractmanagement, technisch management, omgevingsmanagement en projectbeheersing. De behoefte aan deze capaciteit verschilt per project en per projectfase. Om tijdig te kunnen beschikken over gekwalificeerde professionals en de inhuur van tijdelijke capaciteit op een uniforme en beheersbare wijze te organiseren, wenst de Gemeente Den Haag een raamovereenkomst af te sluiten met één brokerdienstverlener. De brokerdienstverlener ondersteunt de gemeente bij het werven, selecteren, contracteren en administratief faciliteren van tijdelijke professionals voor de MIRT-projecten. De Aanbesteding is niet verdeeld in percelen. De gemeente verwacht dat de gevraagde dienstverlening door één marktpartij integraal kan worden uitgevoerd. De gemeente is daarom voornemens één Raamovereenkomst af te sluiten met één Ondernemer.

title: Netherlands – Software package and information systems – Contractbeheersysteem

De opdracht omvat naast de levering en implementatie ook het technisch beheer, onderhoud en de ondersteuning gedurende de looptijd van de overeenkomst. Daarom worden eventuele modules en/of uitbreidingen van de aangeboden oplossing als optionele uitbreiding van de opdracht meegenomen in deze uitvraag. Het programma van eisen en de gunningscriteria zijn erop gericht een contractbeheersysteem aan te schaffen maar tegelijkertijd toekomstbestendig te zijn om de doorontwikkeling richting contractmanagement te implementeren.

title: France – Architectural services for building extensions – Marché de maîtrise d'oeuvre pour l'extension de l'usine de dépollution des eaux usées de SILOE (actuellement 234 000 EH) sur la commune d'Annecy
description: Le présent marché a pour objet la maîtrise d'oeuvre correspondant aux travaux à réaliser dans le cadre de l'extension de l'UDEP SILOE : - en vue de répondre aux enjeux liés à la protection du milieu récepteur dans un contexte de diminution du débit d'étiage, - en tenant compte des besoins futurs de capacité de traitement (à échéance 2035 et prévoyant l'évolution pour les besoins de l'échéance 2050) - en analysant les nouvelles normes de rejet en concertation avec les services de l'Etat et en application de la DERU II - en proposant une vision d'ensemble de la solution à l'horizon 2050 (niveau AVP) L'extension de l'UDEP de SILOE S2 est la première phase d'un projet plus global à horizon 2050 (S3). Cette première phase consiste en la création d'une nouvelle unité de dépollution (S2) sur les parcelles voisines de l'UDEP existante (S1) pour permettre, à l'échelle de l'UDEP existante et de cette extension, de traiter les effluents reçus à horizon 2035/2050. La seconde phase de travaux (hors périmètre du présent marché de MOE) consistera en la réhabilitation de l'UDEP existante (S1) et en la création de nouveaux ouvrages sur S2 et sur d'autres parcelles voisines pour traiter l'intégralité des effluents reçus à horizon 2050. Cette extension comprend : - La construction des ouvrages infrastructures de traitement S2 (phase 1) ; - La construction d'un Nouveau Bâtiment d'Exploitation (NBE) ; - L'intégration des contraintes pour S2 en lien avec l'extension SILOE S3 (phase 2). Le marché de maîtrise d'oeuvre prévoit des missions de base (EP, AVP, PRO, AMT, VISA, DET/OPC, AOR) et des missions complémentaires listées dans le DCE
